description: This file defines a ChatController class in Kotlin, managing chat sessions, message flow, and interaction with a server via a GatewaySession interface. It handles message sending, receiving, session management, health checks, and event handling for a chat application.

classes.name: ChatController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing chat states, sending/receiving messages, handling sessions, and interacting with a gateway session.

methods.name: onDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events by resetting states and clearing pending operations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific session by session key, triggers bootstrap.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key, updating session management accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current session state and related data.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of available sessions, possibly limited.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the thinking level which may control the AI's response style.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session identified by session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments and thinking level.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and awaits acceptance, providing immediate UI feedback.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing chat runs.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Handles different types of gateway events like 'tick', 'health', 'chat', 'agent'.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes or refreshes the chat session, history, and health checks.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Fetches session list from the server.

methods.name: pollHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Polls the health status of the gateway, with debounce.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes chat-related events from the server.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Handles agent-specific events such as response streams or tool calls.

methods.name: parseAssistantDeltaText
methods.description: Extracts assistant's streaming text from delta messages.

methods.name: publishPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Updates the list of pending tool calls.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets up timeout for a pending run.

methods.name: clearPendingRun
methods.description: Clears a pending run and cancels timeout.

methods.name: clearPendingRuns
methods.description: Clears all pending runs and related timeouts.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON into message objects.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Parses message content JSON elements into ChatMessageContent objects.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Parses JSON session list.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts runId from server response JSON.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes thinking level strings into predefined values.
